description:
Advances: specled.api_boundary

Review-bar-override: scoping the block changes what specled.api_boundary.divergence_blocks_refresh currently requires — needs a spec amendment + ADR.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q (finding F29, Medium, consensus: security + api).

has_divergence?/1 is a whole-run boolean applied to a refresh that rewrites every flat tier, so one stuck api_boundary MFA freezes rebaselining for expanded_behavior, typespecs, and use. The attestation path already has the granularity this path lacks — drift_dangling_pairs/1 scopes to subject_id + mfa.

This is consistent with how has_drift?/has_dangling? already behave, so it is not a design objection — the scope is simply undocumented and an adopter debugging a stale unrelated tier will not connect it.

The documentation half LANDED on the release branch (docs/concepts.md now states the block is run-wide and that severity off suppresses the report but not the block). This ticket is the behavioral half only.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.api_boundary

BLOCKED BY specled_-vzd.4. That ticket introduces finding_code/1 + has_code?/2 + the
@drift_code/@dangling_code/@divergence_code attributes and renames drift_dangling_pairs/1. If
this ticket landed first it would write a FIFTH inline `Map.get(f, "code") || Map.get(f, :code)`
copy that vzd.4 then folds in, and vzd.4's rename would land on a function this ticket just
reshaped — a guaranteed same-hunk conflict. After vzd.4, this ticket reduces to an additive
extractor composed from has_code?/2.

DECISION-CLASS: code + spec amendment + ADR, but MERGEABLE after routine review — not held.
The amendment narrows specled.api_boundary.divergence_blocks_refresh
(.spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md:109-119) and its scenario at :224-233 from run-wide to
per-MFA. change_type: narrows-scope. No weakening class fires (no deletion, no modal downgrade,
no scenario-count drop, no polarity loss), so the weakened-id set is empty and
append_only/same_pr_self_authorization cannot fire. The ADR is required by convention and
specled.decisions.frontmatter_contract, not by a gate.

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex
- .spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.*.md  (one new ADR, change_type: narrows-scope)
- test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary_test.exs
- .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md  (surface owner of orchestrator.ex, branch_guard.spec.md:24)
- docs/concepts.md AND .spec/specs/package.spec.md — CORRECTION ONLY, and MANDATORY: the
  documentation half of this finding already landed at docs/concepts.md:336-347. If this ticket
  lands, lines 336-341 ("The block spans the whole run, not just the diverged entry") BECOME
  FALSE and must be corrected in the same PR.
- .spec/realization_hashes.json  (escape hatch only)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex
- all other realization modules

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT scope has_drift?/1 or has_dangling?/1 (orchestrator.ex:686-701). They are run-wide by
  design and the ticket says so. The resulting asymmetry (divergence per-MFA, drift run-wide) is
  a deliberate accepted consequence — put it in the ADR's Consequences section, not the diff.
- Do not change what --accept-drift does.
- Do not rename drift_dangling_pairs/1 — that is vzd.4 item 3, which lands before you.
- Do not merge the entry_hash/1 decode duplication (api_boundary.ex:191-201). It is consumed at
  :120 inside the same cond your divergence logic feeds, so it looks adjacent and inviting. It
  is vzd.4 item 1.

PRECISION POINT THE ADR MUST STATE: refresh_and_commit_hashes/3 (orchestrator.ex:897-920) builds
a TIER -> MFA map, while drift_dangling_pairs/1 (:396-414) yields {subject_id, mfa}. The store
has NO subject dimension, so the achievable exclusion granularity is {tier, mfa}, NOT
{subject_id, mfa}. Two subjects binding the same MFA with one diverged means excluded for both.
Say so explicitly; do not claim a granularity the store cannot express.

Verification:
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix test test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs test/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary_test.exs
  mix test --only spec:specled.api_boundary.divergence_blocks_refresh
  mix test --only spec:specled.api_boundary.divergence_withholds_drift_silencing
  mix format --check-formatted
  make xref
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
NO stub flip: all four tagged_tests blocks in api_boundary.spec.md are already execute: true,
and orchestrator_test.exs already carries
@tag spec: "specled.api_boundary.divergence_blocks_refresh".

Expected diff: 5-6 files, ~220 lines.
